description: Check a Focxle agreement has not been changed. Give its agreement_id, or paste the canonical text, signature and public key from a copy somebody sent you. Anyone can call this, no account needed.

agreement_id.description: Check the agreement Focxle holds under this id.

canonical.description: Or: the canonical text from a copy you were given.

public_key.description: The public key from that copy.

name: agreement_verify
